title: Original M6 zero-span two-label edge case

spec.name: M6.ZeroSpan.anchored_zero
spec.statement: ∀ (a b : M6.Final.BP), a.coeff 0 = 1 → b.coeff 0 = 1 → M6.ActualTransfer.span a b = 0 → a = 1 ∧ b = 1
spec.guidance: max natDegrees=0 implies both degrees0. Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero or ext using coeff_eq_zero above0. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.ZeroSpan.connected_zero
spec.guidance: Unfold Admissible. support_one={0}, gcd_finset=0, gcd N0=N. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.ZeroSpan.signature_one
spec.guidance: Unfold signature and simplify gcd_one/one_gcd. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.ZeroSpan.boundary_loops
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (i : ℕ) (m n : M6.Transfer.Memory 0), M6.Transfer.edgeMatrix (M6.ActualTransfer.boundaryWeight 0 N 1 1 (M6.Pinned.free (2*N)) i) m n = (1 : Polynomial ℤ) + Polynomial.X^2
spec.guidance: Memory0 singleton; shift m bit=n by Subsingleton.elim. Sum Bit=0,1 explicitly. Actual output for polynomial1 equals bit. Boundary factor free s=X^s.val. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.ZeroSpan.character_loops
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (i : ℕ) (m n : M6.Transfer.Memory 0), M6.Transfer.edgeMatrix (M6.ActualTransfer.characterWeight 0 N 1 1 (M6.Pinned.free (2*N)) i) m n = Polynomial.C 2 * ((1 : Polynomial ℤ) + Polynomial.X^2)
spec.guidance: Use free_character_factor, outputs=bit, sum over Bit0,1. (1+X)^2+(1-X)^2=2(1+X²) via ring. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.ZeroSpan.zero_memory_trace
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (W : ℕ → M6.Transfer.Memory 0 → M6.Transfer.Bit → Polynomial ℤ) (p : Polynomial ℤ), (∀ i m n, M6.Transfer.edgeMatrix (W i) m n = p) → M6.Transfer.arrayTrace W N = p^N
spec.guidance: Prove layers W start n only coordinate =p^n by induction, all Memory0 equal default. Or array_trace_matrix with singleton matrix constant p, matrixProduct induction. Count both labels through edgeMatrix premise; no label merger. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.ZeroSpan.boundary_trace_zero
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], M6.ActualTransfer.boundaryTrace N 1 1 (M6.Pinned.free (2*N)) = ((1 : Polynomial ℤ) + Polynomial.X^2)^N
spec.guidance: span1 1=0. scalar_trace_polynomial using actual boundary_edge_bounds, then zero_memory_trace and boundary_loops. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.ZeroSpan.character_trace_zero
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], M6.ActualTransfer.characterTrace N 1 1 (M6.Pinned.free (2*N)) = Polynomial.C ((2 : ℤ)^N) * ((1 : Polynomial ℤ) + Polynomial.X^2)^N
spec.guidance: span1 1=0; scalar_trace_polynomial using character_edge_bounds; zero_memory_trace and character_loops; mul_pow and Polynomial.C_pow. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
